Community & society 3

Discuss a changing society in Thai. This third part asks what's shifting — neighbours grown ห่างเหิน (distant), ชุมชนแออัด (crowded communities), the pull of the city on คนชนบท (rural people), whether โซเชียล (social media) brings คนรุ่นใหม่ (the younger generation) together — and what holds firm: helping in ภัยพิบัติ (disasters), the role of ภาครัฐ (the state), and respect across faiths, from เสรีภาพ (freedom) of religion to มุสลิม (Muslim) neighbours during รอมฎอน (Ramadan). All 19 sentences come with native-speed audio, English translations and word-by-word notes, so the discussion vocabulary sticks by ear.
